messages:
eva: Bringing up peregrine-v0 (q5) on staging  quick smoke shows locale-specific regressions: Korean polite suffixes collapsing to informal forms, Chinese spelled numerals emitted as arabic digits, and Arabic RTL punctuation spacing/reflow issues. Anyone seen this pattern? @li-wei @sanjay :eyes:

li-wei: Can you paste a minimal repro and the eval harness command?

eva: Minimal repro (curl):
`curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY\" -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"peregrine-v0-q5","input":"선생님께서 말씀드리셨습니다: 감사합니다.","max_tokens":64,"temperature":0}'`
Observed (staging peregrine-v0-q5):
- KO input: "선생님께서 말씀드리셨습니다: 감사합니다."
- Output: "선생님 말했어: 고마워."  <-- lost honorific suffix, downgraded politeness

CN numeral case:
- Input: "订单号一二三四，请确认。"
- Output: "订单号1234，请确认。"  <-- digits instead of spelled numerals

AR RTL punctuation case:
- Input: "مرحبا، هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟"
- Output: "مرحبا ,هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟"  <-- stray space before comma and comma appears on LTR side

qa-bot: Quick auto-eval summary:
- ko-politeness-set: BLEU delta -3.4
- cn-numeral-set: CER +2.1
- ar-rtl-punct: F1 -15%

sanjay: Hypothesis: tokenizer/vocab mismatch or quantization merged embeddings for low-frequency honorific tokens shifting logits. Two checks: 1) tokenization diff vs baseline 2) compare logits for suffix tokens pre/post quant.

mina: Note: checkpoint included tokenizer v2.1 artifacts, but our staging inference image defaults to tokenizer v2.0 unless pinned. That explains subwordization shifts. Arabic punctuation spacing likely detokenizer/normalizer behavior.

li-wei: Tokenization diff snippet to run locally:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
new = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v2.1.json')
old = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v2.0.json')
text = '선생님께서 말씀드리셨습니다: 감사합니다.'
print('v2.1 ->', new.encode(text).tokens)
print('v2.0 ->', old.encode(text).tokens)
```
If tokens differ around the honorific suffix we should pin the tokenizer in the model manifest.

sanjay: Also invoke the inference endpoint with `?trace=true` and dump logits around the suffix tokens so we can inspect probability mass shifts.

eva: Plan: 1) run tokenization diff v2.0 vs v2.1 2) rerun generation with model pinned to tokenizer v2.0 (quick smoke) 3) if mismatch -> update onboarding checklist and add pinner; else -> bisect q5 quant pipeline and collect logits.

mina: Onboarding action: always bundle tokenizer.json SHA + vocab.tsv and assert on startup. I'll open a PR to add the assertion in the model loader.

sanjay: If tokenizer pin fixes KO/CN but AR persists, bisect detok/normalize changes (we had a CL altering Arabic punctuation spacing heuristics recently).

eva: Update ~20m: pinned tokenizer v2.0 -> Korean honorifics preserved, CN numerals match baseline. Arabic punctuation still flaky. Conclusion: root cause = tokenizer mismatch + a separate detok regression. I'll bisect detok package and post `?trace=true` logs next.

mina: Please paste failing Arabic trace when ready and I'll add unit tests for the detokenizer.

eva: Will do, thanks :thumbsup:
